data.summary:
Immediately available to Join
18 years of experience in Business Transformation, Process Re-engineering, Banking Operations, Capital Markets. Well versed in Agile, Waterfall, Requirement Elicitation, BRD, FRD, USER Stories across Investment Banking, Custody, Fixed Income Settlements, Payments, and Change Management. Proven track record leading global teams, driving process automation, managing operational risk, and delivering large-scale transformation programs across APAC, EMEA, and US markets. Experienced in stakeholder management, process migration, governance, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
Career Highlights
18 years in Banking Operations, Capital Markets, and Transformation. • Led teams of up to 25+ members across global markets. • Delivered process migrations, automation, and operational excellence initiatives. • Reduced attrition by 90% and improved productivity through automation. • Contributed to recovery of USD 16M+ through claims management initiatives.

raw_sections.experience:
Work Experience
Accenture, Bangalore Assistant Project Manager – Change Management & Business Transformation Dec 2025 to Till Date
Lead change management and transformation initiatives for Banking and Financial Services clients. • Drive stakeholder engagement, business readiness, communication, and adoption strategies for enterprise programs.
Directed the team on 25 members, organizing and leading requirement-gathering workshops (interviews, questionnaires, interface/document analysis, brainstorming, and focus groups) to ensure complete coverage of business needs.
Delivered a major enhancement that achieved 80% on-time trade matching and settlement, through rigorous reconciliation of internal and external data, and strengthening reference and static data governance. • Partner with business, operations, and technology teams to support digital transformation and process
modernization.
Manage UAT readiness, production rollouts, hypercare support, and governance activities. • Handling the Stand-up calls to take updates on the Jira and understand the readiness for automation of activity.
State Street India Pvt Ltd Project Manager/Senior Business Analyst
Sept 2021 to May 2025
• Led a Greenfield project for Claims Monitoring process across financial services, managing end-to-end delivery and
ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business strategy for global banks.
Strengthened governance and controls by establishing clear data ownership, embedding traceability frameworks, and improving reference data accuracy, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
Designed and published KPI dashboards in Power BI to provide stakeholders with real-time visibility of sprint progress, enabling transparent reporting and informed decision-making.
Facilitated Agile delivery by implementing weekly Scrum ceremonies, driving backlog refinement, and closing knowledge gaps through continuous team coaching.
Enhanced stakeholder engagement through regular status meetings and feedback forums, ensuring alignment of

deliverables with business expectations. Introduced process improvements such as an internal contact management tool that reduced reliance on external data sources and streamlined stakeholder communication.
Documented detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, prototypes, and business value, ensuring traceability from requirements to testing and delivery.
Performed gap, scope, and impact analyses using modelling techniques (UML, BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart) to define AS- IS/TO-BE processes and identify optimization opportunities.
Led a 14-member team in requirements elicitation through interviews, questionnaires, interface analysis, document analysis, brainstorming sessions, and focus groups.
Partnered with cross-functional teams during development, integration testing, functional testing, and UAT, ensuring error-free delivery and seamless transition into BAU.
Broadridge Financial Services Associate Project Manager/Business Analyst
May – 2017 to Aug - 2021
Spearheaded the implementation of the settlement system (IMPACT) to extract and monitor real-time settlement status using IMAD references, significantly improving operational visibility and accuracy.
Delivered a major enhancement that achieved 80% on-time trade matching and settlement, through rigorous reconciliation of internal and external data, and strengthening reference and static data governance.
Led AS-IS vs. TO-BE analysis, driving business requirements elicitation and documentation, and translating them into actionable solution designs.
Directed a team of 8 members, organizing and leading requirement-gathering workshops (interviews, questionnaires, interface/document analysis, brainstorming, and focus groups) to ensure complete coverage of business needs.
Partnered with cross-functional teams across development, integration, functional testing, and UAT to deliver an end-to-end solution, ensuring full compliance with business and regulatory expectations.
Coordinated UAT activities, validating sprint outputs and ensuring error-free client delivery through structured testing and issue resolution.
Embedded data governance principles into settlement operations, enhancing decision-making, risk management, and overall control effectiveness.
JP Morgan Chase India Pvt Ltd Operational Analyst
Apr – 2007 to Nov 2016
Ensured accurate reconciliation of trade positions by validating static data attributes, coordinating with global agent banks, and resolving discrepancies through robust reference data controls.
Coordinated large-scale securities transfers by validating reference data, static client data, and settlement instructions, ensuring alignment with market regulations and client requirements.
Conducted comprehensive market restriction and eligibility checks, embedding static data validations to ensure smooth security transfers and regulatory adherence.
Managed post-trade settlement activities with a focus on TMPG Claims, leveraging reference data to investigate, resolve, and prevent recurring discrepancies.
